items.title: Arturo Sandoval interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 12, 2023
items.q: I hear Ruben playing it in Europe... when I wrote it I talked to a couple of good, good violin players here in town and I consulted them about it

ctx.x: I believe it’s a YouTube with a young man, you weren’t playing it, a young man playing it.

Oh Ruben Simeo oh yeah he played it several times. Yes. But you know unfortunately we had everything ready to do a recording here in L.A. and then the beginning of the pandemic started and everything got screwed up.
Well did you decide that it was going to be three movements when you started it or is that something that happens along the way?
